title: Close an issue with its closing comment in one atomic write
description: Chatticus closes a card with a closing comment (evidence or reason) and custom.closing. Today that takes two writes (POST comments, then PATCH status), and a failure between them leaves a closing comment on an open card until the retry. Add an optional comment field on PATCH /{tenant}/{project}/api/issues/{id} that appends a comment in the same journaled write as the field changes (one X-Operation-Id, one revision), with the same author and actor rules as POST comments. Spec first; add the field to @kanbus/api-client. Low priority.
